mechanism: row-to-core balance / paired cyclic row stripes
hypothesis: Assigning two adjacent wide low-precision rows to a block per cyclic stripe may change the row ownership granularity while preserving inter-block work balance.
change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, map each block's full local ordinal range to adjacent row pairs spaced by 2*blockCount. Distribute the partial stripe's first and second lanes independently across blocks so local row counts differ by at most one. Reuse the same ordinal-to-row helper for input, prefetch, and output; arithmetic and tile processing are unchanged.
